```{r setup, include=FALSE}
render_figure_template <- function (arg0_file_path, arg1_options = NULL) {
```

```{r load-stadester-json, include=FALSE}
GAZETTEER_JSON_FILE <- "soviet_post_stalin_settlements.json"
gaz_map <- jsonlite::fromJSON(GAZETTEER_JSON_FILE, simplifyVector = FALSE)
settlements_list <- unname(gaz_map)

first_year_num <- function (arg0_s) {
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(arg0_s$population))
  if (length(yrs) == 0) return(99999)
  return(min(yrs))
}
last_year_num <- function (arg0_s) {
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(arg0_s$population))
  if (length(yrs) == 0) return(-99999)
  return(max(yrs))
}

ord_idx <- order(
  vapply(settlements_list, first_year_num, numeric(1)),
  vapply(settlements_list, function (s) as.character(s$name), character(1))
)
settlements_list <- settlements_list[ord_idx]

fmt_other_names <- function (arg0_s) {
  onames <- unlist(arg0_s$other_names)
  if (length(onames) == 0) return("-")
  clean_vec <- unique(as.character(onames))
  clean_vec <- clean_vec[nzchar(clean_vec) & tolower(clean_vec) != tolower(arg0_s$name)]
  if (length(clean_vec) == 0) clean_vec <- unique(as.character(onames))
  return(paste(head(clean_vec, 2L), collapse = "; "))
}

fmt_year_lbl <- function (arg0_y) {
  y <- as.numeric(arg0_y)
  if (y < 0) return(paste0(abs(round(y)), "BC"))
  return(as.character(round(y)))
}

fmt_sname <- function (arg0_nm) {
  s <- as.character(arg0_nm)
  s <- gsub("Dniprodzerzhynsk", "Dnipro-dzerzhynsk", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("Dnipropetrovsk", "Dnipro-petrovsk", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("Voroshilovgrad", "Voroshilov-grad", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("Novocheboksarsk", "Novo-cheboksarsk", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("Nizhnevartovsk", "Nizhne-vartovsk", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("Blagoveshchensk", "Blago-veshchensk", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("Severobaikalsk", "Severo-baikalsk", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("Chernyakhovsk", "Chernyak-hovsk", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("Severodonetsk", "Severo-donetsk", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("Novocherkassk", "Novocher-kassk", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky", "Petropav-lovsk-Kamchatsky", s, fixed = TRUE)
  return(s)
}

fmt_span <- function (arg0_s) {
  y1 <- first_year_num(arg0_s)
  y2 <- last_year_num(arg0_s)
  if (y1 == y2) return(fmt_year_lbl(y1))
  if (y1 < 0 && y2 < 0) return(paste0(abs(y1), "-", abs(y2), "BC"))
  if (y1 > 0 && y2 > 0) return(paste0(y1, "-", y2))
  return(paste0(fmt_year_lbl(y1), " - ", fmt_year_lbl(y2)))
}

fmt_num_eu <- function (arg0_val) {
  if (is.null(arg0_val) || is.na(arg0_val)) return("-")
  v <- as.numeric(arg0_val)
  if (v >= 1000000) {
    s <- formatC(v / 1000000.0, format = "f", digits = 2L, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
    s <- sub("(,[0-9]*?[1-9])0+$", "\\1", s, perl = TRUE)
    s <- sub(",0+$", "", s, perl = TRUE)
    return(paste0(s, "M"))
  }
  if (v >= 1000) {
    s <- formatC(v / 1000.0, format = "f", digits = 1L, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
    s <- sub("(,[0-9]*?[1-9])0+$", "\\1", s, perl = TRUE)
    s <- sub(",0+$", "", s, perl = TRUE)
    return(paste0(s, "k"))
  }
  return(as.character(round(v)))
}

fmt_coord_pair <- function (arg0_coords) {
  lat <- as.numeric(arg0_coords[[1]])
  lon <- as.numeric(arg0_coords[[2]])
  lat_s <- paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", abs(lat))), if (lat >= 0) "°N" else "°S")
  lon_s <- paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", abs(lon))), if (lon >= 0) "°E" else "°W")
  return(paste0(lat_s, ", ", lon_s))
}

fmt_pop_series <- function (arg0_s, arg1_ymin = -99999, arg2_ymax = 99999) {
  pop_map <- arg0_s$population
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(pop_map))
  vals <- as.numeric(unlist(pop_map))
  keep <- which(yrs >= arg1_ymin & yrs <= arg2_ymax)
  if (length(keep) == 0) return("-")
  parts <- vapply(keep, function (idx) {
    paste0(fmt_year_lbl(yrs[idx]), ": ", fmt_num_eu(vals[idx]))
  }, character(1))
  return(paste(parts, collapse = "; "))
}

get_pop_window_val <- function (arg0_s, arg1_ymin, arg2_ymax) {
  pop_map <- arg0_s$population
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(pop_map))
  vals <- as.numeric(unlist(pop_map))
  keep <- which(yrs >= arg1_ymin & yrs <= arg2_ymax)
  if (length(keep) == 0) return("-")
  idx <- keep[which.max(yrs[keep])]
  return(fmt_num_eu(vals[idx]))
}
```
```{r load-region-labels, include=FALSE}
sum_json <- jsonlite::fromJSON((if (file.exists("soviet_post_stalin_summary.json")) "soviet_post_stalin_summary.json" else "../../_shared/_gis_cache/soviet_post_stalin_summary.json"), simplifyVector = FALSE)
reg_lbl_map <- setNames(
  vapply(sum_json$regions, function (r) {
    s <- strsplit(as.character(r$name), " (", fixed = TRUE)[[1]][1]
    s <- gsub("Dnipropetrovsk", "Dnipro-petrovsk", s, fixed = TRUE)
    s <- gsub("Voroshilovgrad", "Voroshilov-grad", s, fixed = TRUE)
    return(s)
  }, character(1)),
  vapply(sum_json$regions, function (r) as.character(r$id), character(1))
)
get_rid <- function (arg0_s) {
  rid <- arg0_s$region_id
  if (is.null(rid) || !nzchar(as.character(rid))) return("")
  return(as.character(rid))
}
fmt_reg_short <- function (arg0_s) {
  rid <- get_rid(arg0_s)
  if (nzchar(rid) && rid %in% names(reg_lbl_map)) {
    return(reg_lbl_map[[rid]])
  }
  return(as.character(arg0_s$country))
}
```

# Abstract

Between Stalin's death in March 1953 and the dissolution of the USSR in December 1991, the urban population of the seven western and northern union republics - the Russian SFSR and the Ukrainian, Byelorussian, Lithuanian, Latvian, Estonian and Moldavian SSRs - grew by nearly three-fifths from 120,98M at the 1959 census to 193,14M in 1989 across the catalogued settlement network. Alongside the steady growth of the republican capitals and older provincial centres, post-Stalin economic planning created hundreds of new towns: Volga, Dnieper and Angara-Yenisei hydroelectric cities, automotive and petrochemical monocities, Moscow science cities, closed nuclear and naval towns (*ZATO*) and Arctic oil, gas, diamond and railway settlements across West Siberia, Yakutia and the Baikal-Amur Mainline.

This gazetteer traces the population histories of 8.614 towns, urban-type settlements and large villages across all 41 regions from 1953 to 1991. Together with the four post-war Soviet censuses of 1959, 1970, 1979 and 1989 and the opening (1953) and closing (1991) benchmarks, the tables record the pre-evacuation populations of towns inside the 1986 Chernobyl Exclusion Zone and the declassified headcounts of the secret nuclear and naval cities omitted from contemporary Soviet publications.


# Methodology

The 8.614 settlements in this gazetteer span all 41 regions of the Estonian SSR (Region 1), Latvian SSR (Region 2), Lithuanian SSR (Region 3), Moldavian SSR (Region 4), the Kaliningrad Oblast RSFSR exclave (Region 5), the Byelorussian SSR (Regions 6-8), the Ukrainian SSR (Regions 9-15) and the mainland RSFSR (Regions 16-41) [@tssu_1962_perepis_1959; @tssu_1972_perepis_1970; @tssu_1984_perepis_1979; @goskomstat_1991_perepis_1989; @goskomstat_1992_demograficheskiy_ezhegodnik_1991]. Population figures are drawn from the All-Union census returns of January 1959, January 1970, January 1979 and January 1989, supplemented by TsSU and Goskomstat urban registers for 1953 and 1991, post-Soviet declassified *Minsredmash* series for closed nuclear and naval cities, and April 1986 pre-evacuation counts for settlements evacuated after the Chernobyl accident [@lappo_1997_geografiya_gorodov; @rowland_1996_russia_secret_cities_zato; @iaea_2006_chernobyl_environmental_consequences].

The regional tables in the Results section group the towns into four geographic zones: the 371 settlements of the Baltic SSRs, the Moldavian SSR and Kaliningrad Oblast (Regions 1-5); the 2.602 settlements of the Byelorussian and Ukrainian SSRs (Regions 6-15); the 4.383 settlements of European Russia, the Volga-Ural republics and the North Caucasus (Regions 16-30); and the 1.258 settlements of Siberia, Yakutia and the Far East (Regions 31-41). The Appendix then presents a 41-region urban population summary summing the complete 1959-1989 Soviet census series alongside 1953 and 1991 benchmarks.


# Results

## Baltic SSRs, Moldavian SSR and Kaliningrad Exclave

In the western borderlands (Regions 1-5), urban growth followed contrasting paths: heavy industrial migration into Tallinn, Riga, the Ida-Virumaa oil-shale basin and the left-bank Dniester towns of Tiraspol, Bender and Ribnita, balanced ten-pole regional urbanisation across Lithuania, and naval and fishing expansion in Kaliningrad Oblast (Table \ref{tab:western-ssrs-kaliningrad}).

```{r tab-western-ssrs-kaliningrad, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
all_reg_ids <- vapply(sum_json$regions, function (r) as.character(r$id), character(1))
west_ids <- all_reg_ids[1:5]
sub_w <- Filter(function (s) get_rid(s) %in% west_ids, settlements_list)
sub_w <- sub_w[order(match(vapply(sub_w, get_rid, character(1)), west_ids), vapply(sub_w, function (s) as.character(s$name), character(1)))]

df_w <- data.frame(
  Settlement = vapply(sub_w, function (s) fmt_sname(s$name), character(1)),
  Region = vapply(sub_w, fmt_reg_short, character(1)),
  Coords = vapply(sub_w, function (s) fmt_coord_pair(s$coords), character(1)),
  Y1953 = vapply(sub_w, function (s) get_pop_window_val(s, 1953, 1953), character(1)),
  Y1959 = vapply(sub_w, function (s) get_pop_window_val(s, 1959, 1959), character(1)),
  Y1970 = vapply(sub_w, function (s) get_pop_window_val(s, 1970, 1970), character(1)),
  Y1979 = vapply(sub_w, function (s) get_pop_window_val(s, 1979, 1979), character(1)),
  Y1989 = vapply(sub_w, function (s) get_pop_window_val(s, 1989, 1989), character(1)),
  Y1991 = vapply(sub_w, function (s) get_pop_window_val(s, 1991, 1991), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
render_table_template(
  df_w,
  list(
    caption = "Populations of 371 republican capitals, regional centres, industrial towns and closed naval or nuclear settlements across Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Moldavia and Kaliningrad Oblast from 1953 to 1991.",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Region (1-5)", "Coords", "1953", "1959", "1970", "1979", "1989", "1991"),
    label = "tab:western-ssrs-kaliningrad"
  )
)
```

## Byelorussian and Ukrainian SSRs

Across Belarus and Ukraine (Regions 6-15), post-war urban growth was led by Minsk, Kyiv, the western oblast capitals, the Dnieper hydroelectric and metallurgical bend and the Black Sea ports, while the April 1986 Chernobyl accident forced the evacuation of Pripyat, Chernobyl and Poliske and the construction of Slavutych (Table \ref{tab:belarus-ukraine}).

```{r tab-belarus-ukraine, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
bu_ids <- all_reg_ids[6:15]
sub_bu <- Filter(function (s) get_rid(s) %in% bu_ids, settlements_list)
sub_bu <- sub_bu[order(vapply(sub_bu, function (s) paste0(sprintf("%02d", as.integer(sub("\\..*$", "", fmt_reg_short(s)))), "_", s$name), character(1)))]

df_bu <- data.frame(
  Settlement = vapply(sub_bu, function (s) fmt_sname(s$name), character(1)),
  Region = vapply(sub_bu, fmt_reg_short, character(1)),
  Coords = vapply(sub_bu, function (s) fmt_coord_pair(s$coords), character(1)),
  Y1953 = vapply(sub_bu, function (s) get_pop_window_val(s, 1953, 1953), character(1)),
  Y1959 = vapply(sub_bu, function (s) get_pop_window_val(s, 1959, 1959), character(1)),
  Y1970 = vapply(sub_bu, function (s) get_pop_window_val(s, 1970, 1970), character(1)),
  Y1979 = vapply(sub_bu, function (s) get_pop_window_val(s, 1979, 1979), character(1)),
  Y1989 = vapply(sub_bu, function (s) get_pop_window_val(s, 1986, 1989), character(1)),
  Y1991 = vapply(sub_bu, function (s) get_pop_window_val(s, 1991, 1991), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
render_table_template(
  df_bu,
  list(
    caption = "Populations of 2.602 settlements across the Byelorussian and Ukrainian SSRs (Regions 6-15) from 1953 to 1991, including 1986 pre-evacuation figures for towns in the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone.",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Region (6-15)", "Coords", "1953", "1959", "1970", "1979", "1986/89", "1991"),
    label = "tab:belarus-ukraine"
  )
)
```

## European Russia, Volga-Urals and the North Caucasus

In the European RSFSR, the Volga-Ural republics and the North Caucasus (Regions 16-30), metropolitan expansion in Moscow and Leningrad, the Volga-Kama automotive and petrochemical boomtowns (Tolyatti, Naberezhnye Chelny, Nizhnekamsk and Volzhsky), the Ural closed nuclear towns and the restored capitals of Elista, Grozny, Nalchik and Cherkessk contrasted with rural contraction in the surrounding forest and black-earth villages (Table \ref{tab:european-russia}).

```{r tab-european-russia, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
    label = "tab:european-russia"
  )

```

## Siberia, Yakutia and the Far East

East of the Urals (Regions 31-41), older Trans-Siberian and Kuzbass industrial cities were joined by the oil and gas boomtowns of the Middle Ob and Yamal (Surgut, Nizhnevartovsk, Nefteyugansk, Novy Urengoy, Noyabrsk and Nadym), the Angara-Yenisei hydroelectric cities (Bratsk, Angarsk, Ust-Ilimsk, Divnogorsk and Sayanogorsk), the diamond and coal towns of Yakutia (Mirny, Udachny and Neryungri) and the hubs of the Baikal-Amur Mainline and Pacific coast (Table \ref{tab:siberia-fareast}).

```{r tab-siberia-fareast, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Region (31-41)", "Coords", "1953", "1959", "1970", "1979", "1989", "1991"),
    label = "tab:siberia-fareast"
  )
```

# Conclusion

Across the 8.614 settlements catalogued in this gazetteer, the post-Stalin decades marked the peak of Soviet urban and frontier expansion. Between 1953 and 1991, rural out-migration from the European forest and forest-steppe zones and state investment in automotive, hydroelectric, nuclear and hydrocarbon complexes created a dense hierarchy of regional capitals and specialised industrial towns. With the end of the USSR in December 1991 and the withdrawal of northern wage and transport subsidies, many Arctic mining towns and single-industry *monogoroda* entered demographic contraction, making the 1989-1991 benchmarks the historical high point of the late-Soviet urban network.


# Appendix

## Regional Urban Population Summary

Table \ref{tab:regional-summary} sums the population of all 8.614 catalogued settlements across the 41 post-Stalin regions at the six Soviet-era benchmarks from 1953 to 1991 [@tssu_1962_perepis_1959; @goskomstat_1991_perepis_1989].

```{r tab-regional-summary, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
get_raw_num <- function (arg0_s, arg1_y) {
  v <- arg0_s$population[[as.character(arg1_y)]]
  if (is.null(v)) return(NA_real_)
  as.numeric(v)
}

bench_yrs <- c(1953L, 1959L, 1970L, 1979L, 1989L, 1991L)
sum_rows <- lapply(seq_along(sum_json$regions), function (i) {
  r <- sum_json$regions[[i]]
  rid <- as.character(r$id)
  sub_s <- Filter(function (s) identical(get_rid(s), rid), settlements_list)
  sums <- vapply(bench_yrs, function (y) {
    vals <- vapply(sub_s, function (s) get_raw_num(s, y), numeric(1))
    fmt_num_eu(sum(vals, na.rm = TRUE))
  }, character(1))
  matched <- Filter(function (s) {
    v1 <- get_raw_num(s, 1959L)
    v2 <- get_raw_num(s, 1989L)
    !is.na(v1) && v1 > 0 && !is.na(v2) && v2 > 0
  }, sub_s)
  pct_s <- if (length(matched) == 0) "-" else {
    m59 <- sum(vapply(matched, function (s) get_raw_num(s, 1959L), numeric(1)))
    m89 <- sum(vapply(matched, function (s) get_raw_num(s, 1989L), numeric(1)))
    pct <- round((m89 - m59) / m59 * 100, 1)
    paste0(if (pct > 0) "+" else "", sub(",0$", "", gsub("\\.", ",", format(pct, nsmall = 1, trim = TRUE))), "%")
  }
  data.frame(
    `Region (Towns)` = paste0(reg_lbl_map[[rid]], " (", length(sub_s), ")"),
    `1953` = sums[1], `1959` = sums[2], `1970` = sums[3],
    `1979` = sums[4], `1989` = sums[5], `1991` = sums[6],
    `1959-1989` = pct_s,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})
df_reg_sum <- do.call(rbind, sum_rows)

tot_sums <- vapply(bench_yrs, function (y) {
  vals <- vapply(settlements_list, function (s) get_raw_num(s, y), numeric(1))
  fmt_num_eu(sum(vals, na.rm = TRUE))
}, character(1))
tot_m <- Filter(function (s) {
  v1 <- get_raw_num(s, 1959L)
  v2 <- get_raw_num(s, 1989L)
  !is.na(v1) && v1 > 0 && !is.na(v2) && v2 > 0
}, settlements_list)
tm59 <- sum(vapply(tot_m, function (s) get_raw_num(s, 1959L), numeric(1)))
tm89 <- sum(vapply(tot_m, function (s) get_raw_num(s, 1989L), numeric(1)))
tpct <- round((tm89 - tm59) / tm59 * 100, 1)
tpct_s <- paste0(if (tpct > 0) "+" else "", sub(",0$", "", gsub("\\.", ",", format(tpct, nsmall = 1, trim = TRUE))), "%")

tot_row <- data.frame(
  `Region (Towns)` = paste0("All 41 Regions (", length(settlements_list), " settlements)"),
  `1953` = tot_sums[1], `1959` = tot_sums[2], `1970` = tot_sums[3],
  `1979` = tot_sums[4], `1989` = tot_sums[5], `1991` = tot_sums[6],
  `1959-1989` = tpct_s,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
df_reg_sum <- rbind(df_reg_sum, tot_row)

render_table_template(
  df_reg_sum,
  list(
    caption = "Combined urban population of all 8.614 catalogued settlements across the 41 regions from 1953 to 1991, with matched-cohort growth between the 1959 and 1989 All-Union Censuses.",
    label = "tab:regional-summary"
  )
)
```
